5ca6748a37b88b269472dad9: Oona's friend must visit a doctor when he breaks a bone in his tail.
Molly, Gil and the Guppies must lead a baby dolphin named Buddy to the surprise birthday party his pod is throwing for him.
A nature show host teaches the Guppies about Australian animals.
Jesters Goby and Gil arrive in the Kingdom of NeverLaugh, where King Grumpfish decrees that he'll outlaw laughter if no one can make him laugh before sundown.
The Bubble Guppies learn about dinosaurs.
The Guppies prepare for a game of fishketball by practicing bouncing, throwing, catching and playing together as a team.
The Bubble Guppies learn about outer space.
Molly performs in the quick-change dress-up match during Fashion Week in Bubbletucky and ends up on the cover of a fashion magazine.
Excited that Zooli is getting a new pet, the Guppies try to guess what kind of animal it is; Zooli loves many creatures, so her new pet could be anything in the animal kingdom.
On the hottest day of the year, Rangers Goby and Gil's job is to make sure pedestrians reach the lake safely; however, Bigfoot causes issues when he removes the stop signs from the park.

In the Gourmet Galaxy, everyone loves yummy food, but when Gen. Yuck turns everything icky, only a recipe for delicious moon muffins can stop her; master chef Goby and his apprentice, Deema, must bake those muffins and save the galaxy.
When Petunia the Dragon moves to the Kingdom of Flowers, everyone is afraid of her fearsome roar except for Zooli, who befriends Petunia and shows her friends how lovable Petunia really is.
Gil and his friends dive into Gil's favorite books to find his missing library card.
Mail carrier Molly tries to deliver a Friendship Day card for someone named Alison in a place called Wonderland; the card-stealing Queen of Hearts bans Friendship Day across the land.
The Guppies must work together to turn nectar into honey for the queen bee's tea time.
The Mayor gets a tummy ache while training for Bubbletucky's annual marathon and has to go to the hospital to get checked out.
Chicken Farmers Deema and Goby discover an unusual egg on their farm one morning, and set off on a bayou river adventure to find the egg's mama.
Dirty Deema steals Molly and Gil's soap and makes the Kingdom of Clean very dirty; Molly and Gil have to get their soap back and clean up the kingdom.
Goby and Gil go on a quest to get a geode at the top of a volcano, then try to make it back to the Rocky Valley Rock Show in time to enter the contest for best rock.
A veterinarian takes care of Bubble Puppy when he has a cold.
When supervillain Felina Meow starts turning all the dogs at the annual dog show into cats, it's up to superheroes Puppy Girl and Super Pup to stop her.
The Monster Machines are eager to see Darington's stunt track, but Crusher tricks Darington, sending him far away.
When Space Commander Megan is marooned on Pluto, the robot heroes race through wormholes, shoot past ice volcanoes, and blast straight through an asteroid field to bring their new friend back home.
When Blaze and Starla discover a map that leads to the legendary Bouncing Bull Racetrack, the friends set out on a Wild West quest to find the track and take the ride of their lives.
Gasquatch has been saving his money to buy a toy, but when his money goes missing Blaze must help him find it before the toy store closes.

Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are watching white whales in Adventure Bay when their boat hits a rock and starts to sink; the PAW Patrol must track down some loose penguins and help them return to the land of ice and snow.
When Rocky loses his voice, Matea the parrot helps him bark out his pup pack tools; the Merpups return to help the PAW Patrol on a rescue.
When Daring Danny sinks the PAW Patroller, the pups must find a way to raise their rig; the pups team up with Alex's mini patrol to retrieve mysteriously missing items.
Ryder and the pups must keep Giant Alex busy so that he does not cause damage in Adventure Bay; the PAW Patrol must rescue Cap'n Turbot's cousin.
City-slicker umbrella sellers Molly and Gil set up shop in the Amazon rainforest.
The Guppies help a friendly pirate search for treasure using a map.
The Bubble Guppies learn about construction while building a doghouse for Bubble Puppy.
The Guppies are excited for China's Lunar New Year Festival, where they will operate a giant festival dragon in the grand parade.

Paddington is accidentally delivered inside a wardrobe to Mr. Curry's house and must get out before he is discovered; Paddington tries to help Judy with her geography homework and ends up being the subject of it.

Mr. Brown forgets to get Mrs. Brown a birthday present, so Paddington decides to hold a surprise party; when Judy does not like violin lessons and hides from Ms. Potts, Paddington takes up the challenge.

Paddington decides to make a scrapbook of memories to show Aunt Lucy and tries to include all his friends; Paddington decides to dig a tunnel through the center of the Earth to Peru but ends up in Mr. Curry's greenhouse.
Paddington's excited about the grand opening of the city farm, but the animals escape when the gate is left open; Baaz teaches Jonathan and Paddington about upcycling.
Paddington learns about bees and decides to help them make honey by planting a flower garden; there's a heatwave in Windsor Gardens and Mateo has sold out of ice cream.
The Browns have new neighbors and Tom is full of tales, like there's a goblin in the garden and her dad is an astronaut; Paddington, Jonathan and Judy decide to create a newspaper.
Paddington has three chances to shoot a meteor shower using Mr. Gruber's antique camera; Paddington enters Mr. Brown in a talent contest.

On the U.S.S. Recycler, Captain Deema and her crew strive to leave every planet cleaner than they found it; however, their mission is put to the test when a crew of messy Litterbugs, led by the evil Garbage Khan, take over their ship.

Before Fight Night, the officers have to seize all proceeds from crime.
Andy worries Duncan may not be suited to the job; when the body of an executed gang leader is found, 15 Division works to prevent a gang war from breaking out; Gail makes a harrowing discovery.
